description: This file contains shell script functions for configuring network switch devices in OpenWrt. It includes functions to set up switch devices and load their configuration based on the OpenWrt network configuration system.

methods.name: setup_switch_dev
methods.description: Configures a network switch device by initializing its name, verifying its existence, bringing the device up, and loading its switch configuration.

methods.name: setup_switch
methods.description: Loads network configuration and applies setup to each switch device specified in the configuration.
